title: Student AI Study - Video First Runway Clips

clips.prompt: Locked vertical frame with gentle push-in. Student looks confused, taps the textbook once, then notices the phone glow. Natural blink and small head movement. Keep the frame clean. Do not add new text.
Student lifts the phone slightly over the textbook as if taking a photo. A soft scan light moves across the page. Natural hand movement, clean parallax. Do not add new text.
The three context bubbles gently appear and pulse near the phone: class, topic, doubt. Student points to the page. Phone assistant nods. Keep text minimal and readable. No extra text.
The phone step cards light up one by one. Student expression changes to an aha moment. Textbook diagram glows softly. Keep movement smooth and educational. Do not add extra text.
Student writes in notebook. Phone shows a hint card, not a final answer. Pencil moves, hint card gently pops, AI helper encourages. Keep text minimal and readable. Do not add extra text.
Notebook answer receives a green checkmark and a small correction bubble. Student compares notebook and phone. Gentle UI motion, no dramatic camera movement. Do not add extra text.

Final balanced study setup. Student, AI phone, textbook, and teacher verification nodes glow one by one. Connecting lines pulse gently. Confident student smile. Keep minimal text readable. No extra text.
